/usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S -B - <<'ROOT_SPACE_FIXED'
import base64,hashlib,json,os,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/opt/jjikmuk-cd/bin')
for p in (root,*root.parents):
 s=p.lstat();assert not p.is_symlink() and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022
assert os.geteuid()==0 and sys.flags.isolated and sys.flags.no_site
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True;sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
raw=base64.b64decode('',validate=True)
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='2df1903d561a45934ea31e0b74999063394b5ee646f2e8462cdbc93ae5924aef'
namespace={'__name__':'reviewed_root_space'}
exec(compile(raw,'<reviewed-root-space>','exec'),namespace)
try:
 print(json.dumps(namespace['main']('inspect')))
except Exception as e:
 code=str(e) if isinstance(e,ValueError) and __import__('re').fullmatch('[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,79}',str(e)) else 'ROOT_SPACE_FAILED_KEEP_RECORDS'
 print(json.dumps({'status':'STOPPED','codes':[code]}));sys.exit(1)
